title: Configuration Drift Causes Feature Flag Evaluation Failure
description: Feature flag service configuration drifted between regions. The 'new-checkout-flow' flag was enabled in us-east-1 but disabled in eu-west-1 due to a manual config change that wasn't synced. Users in EU experienced broken checkout.
initial_symptoms: EU users unable to complete checkout (US users fine)
Feature flag 'new-checkout-flow' returns false in EU
No deployment or code change at incident time

evidence_catalog.summary: Checkout failure rate in eu-west-1 spiked to 95% at 14:00 UTC; us-east-1 normal
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT failure_rate FROM checkout_metrics WHERE region='eu-west-1'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate region-specific checkout metrics

evidence_catalog.summary: Feature flag new-checkout-flow is disabled in eu-west-1 (set false at 13:55 UTC)
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create feature flag config with region override

evidence_catalog.summary: Feature flag new-checkout-flow is enabled in us-east-1
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create feature flag config for US region

evidence_catalog.summary: Config audit log shows manual change: new-checkout-flow set to false in eu-west-1 by user 'ops-engineer-1'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create config audit log entry

evidence_catalog.summary: Trace shows checkout-service checking feature flag, receiving false, returning 'Feature unavailable'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate trace showing feature flag check

changes.summary: Feature flag new-checkout-flow manually disabled in eu-west-1

causal_chain.from_description: Manual config change disabled feature flag in eu-west-1 only
causal_chain.to_description: Checkout service evaluates flag, gets false, returns 'Feature unavailable'

causal_chain.from_description: Flag disabled in EU but enabled in US (config drift)
causal_chain.to_description: EU users see checkout failure; US users unaffected

contributing_factors: Manual config changes not tracked in Git

must_not_claim: Code deployment caused EU checkout failure

misleading_or_confounding_signals: No deployment at incident time (config change only)
US region works fine (misleading - suggests code is fine)

required_checks.description: Check feature flag status per region
required_checks.expected_outcome: Flag false in eu-west-1, true in us-east-1

required_checks.description: Check config audit log for recent changes
required_checks.expected_outcome: Manual change at 13:55 UTC by ops-engineer-1

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Re-enable feature flag in eu-west-1; implement config sync across regions; add drift detection
test_plan: Add config drift detection to CI
